claims.name: QuotaProofs.reserve_accepted
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.reserve state amount).accepted = true ↔ state.used ≤ state.capacity ∧ amount ≤ state.capacity - state.used

claims.name: QuotaProofs.reserve_preserves
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  state.used ≤ state.capacity → (Quota.reserve state amount).state.used ≤ (Quota.reserve state amount).state.capacity

claims.name: QuotaProofs.reserve_rejected
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.reserve state amount).accepted = false → (Quota.reserve state amount).state = state

claims.name: QuotaProofs.reserve_exact
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.reserve state amount).accepted = true →
    (Quota.reserve state amount).state.capacity = state.capacity ∧
      (Quota.reserve state amount).state.used.toNat = state.used.toNat + amount.toNat

claims.name: QuotaProofs.release_accepted
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.release state amount).accepted = true ↔ state.used ≤ state.capacity ∧ amount ≤ state.used

claims.name: QuotaProofs.release_preserves
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  state.used ≤ state.capacity → (Quota.release state amount).state.used ≤ (Quota.release state amount).state.capacity

claims.name: QuotaProofs.release_rejected
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.release state amount).accepted = false → (Quota.release state amount).state = state

claims.name: QuotaProofs.release_exact
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64),
  (Quota.release state amount).accepted = true →
    (Quota.release state amount).state.capacity = state.capacity ∧
      (Quota.release state amount).state.used.toNat + amount.toNat = state.used.toNat

claims.name: QuotaProofs.remaining_exact
claims.statement:
∀ (state : Quota.State),
  state.used ≤ state.capacity → (Quota.remaining state).toNat + state.used.toNat = state.capacity.toNat
